$schema-note: Canonical registry of Owlette web env vars. KEYS + metadata only — values NEVER live here, they stay in the providers. Edit this file when you add/remove/move an env var, then run `node scripts/sync-env.mjs check`. See .claude/skills/env-management.md.

classes.public: NEXT_PUBLIC_* — inlined into the client bundle at build time; not secret. Synced non-sensitive so values stay readable in Vercel.
classes.config: Non-secret app configuration (emails, ids, endpoints, flags). Synced non-sensitive.
classes.must-match: Sensitive AND silently catastrophic if it differs between mirror targets: SESSION_SECRET logs everyone out, MFA_ENCRYPTION_KEY locks out 2FA users, LLM_ENCRYPTION_KEY breaks stored Cortex keys. Synced --sensitive.

LLM_ENCRYPTION_KEY.note: mismatch between railway-prod and vercel-prod breaks decryption of stored LLM provider keys

MFA_ENCRYPTION_KEY.note: mismatch locks out every 2FA user on failover — values must be byte-identical across mirror targets

NEXT_PUBLIC_TURNSTILE_SITE_KEY.note: sitekey is public by design (rendered in the page). One widget covers owlette.app, dev.owlette.app, localhost, 127.0.0.1 — same value everywhere

RATE_LIMIT_OBSERVE_ONLY.note: dev-only — rate limiting runs in observe (non-blocking) mode

SESSION_SECRET.note: mismatch invalidates every session cookie on failover — all users logged out

STRIPE_SECRET_KEY.note: live-mode key — prod origins only. Both origins must hold the SAME key or a failover mid-checkout mints customers in a different Stripe account than the webhook mirrors

STRIPE_SECRET_KEY_TEST.note: test-mode key — dev only. Read only when STRIPE_SECRET_KEY is unset (see web/lib/stripe.server.ts); never set both on one target

STRIPE_PRICE_CORE_MACHINE.note: metered price id for core ($10/machine/month). Mode-specific VALUE: dev holds the Test-mode id, prod the Live-mode id — same key name in both (billing-system task 1.1)

STRIPE_PRICE_PRO_MACHINE.note: metered price id for pro ($50/machine/month). Mode-specific value, same as the core price key

STRIPE_PRICE_PRO_STORAGE_OVERAGE.note: metered price id for roost storage overage ($0.05/GB). Maps to the pro tier in the webhook's price→tier resolution

STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET.note: Live-mode signing secret for /api/billing/stripe-webhook. ONE Stripe endpoint (owlette.app) is served by both origins behind the load balancer, so railway-prod and vercel-prod must match or every webhook 400s on failover

STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET_TEST.note: Test-mode signing secret for dev.owlette.app. The route prefers STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET and falls back to this, so dev can never verify a Live-mode event

TURNSTILE_HOSTNAMES.note: per-deployment frontend hostname allowlist checked against the siteverify response — dev: dev.owlette.app, prod: owlette.app. NEVER include localhost in a prod value

TURNSTILE_SECRET.note: one Turnstile widget serves both origins, so railway-prod and vercel-prod must match or failover breaks register + forgot-password

W8_1_DRILL_TS.note: temporary security-drill marker (wave 8.1) — remove from Railway + this manifest when the drill is retired
